tools.name: find_horses
tools.description: Find horses, jockeys and trainers by name, with their ids (for get_runner_form), most recently seen first.

tools.name: find_leagues
tools.description: Find leagues (competitions) of a sport and their ids, optionally by name or country (also matches official_name, the competition's official or Wikidata name where known). Free.

tools.name: find_teams
tools.description: Find teams by name, with their ids, country, venue and leagues.

tools.name: get_boxing_event
tools.description: One boxing event with every bout from the main event down: weight class, world titles at stake (WBA, WBC, IBF, WBO, Ring), fighters, result, method (KO, TKO, UD, SD, MD, RTD, DQ, TD, NC, draw), round, time, rounds scheduled.

tools.name: get_boxing_events
tools.description: Boxing events of the last and the current year from Wikipedia: fight cards and world title fights, with date, venue, city, status and the main event's winner (cite the attribution). The current world champions: get_standings with sport boxing.

tools.name: get_boxing_fighter
tools.description: A boxer (fighter_id): birth date, country, height, reach, stance and professional record (Wikipedia/Wikidata), world titles held now, latest bouts; or find boxers by name.

tools.name: get_bracket
tools.description: A knock-out bracket: rounds in playing order, ties with their legs, aggregate (soccer: goals after extra time), the side that advanced and how (score, aggregate, extra_time, penalties, walkover, next_round), and from: the tie a side won to get there. tools.name: get_facts
tools.description: Ready fact sentences for a match or team, most important first: form, streaks, records, head-to-head, table and stakes; after a match the story and the runs it ended. tools.name: get_golf_leaderboard
tools.description: A golf tournament's leaderboard: position (tied), to par, strokes per round, thru and today while live, earnings, missed cut or withdrawn, and per-player stats (birdies, eagles, driving distance and accuracy, greens in regulation, putts); holes=true adds hole-by-hole scores.

tools.name: get_golf_player
tools.description: A golfer's profile (country, birth date and place, PGA Tour rank) and season results from our leaderboards with events, wins, top 10s, cuts made and earnings (player_id); or find golfers by name.

tools.name: get_golf_tournaments
tools.description: Golf tournaments of the PGA Tour and LPGA by date: course, location, purse, status and the leader or winner. Leaderboards exist for the PGA Tour only. The season money list: get_standings with sport golf.

tools.name: get_h2h
tools.description: Head-to-head of two teams (soccer by default; any team sport with results: basketball, baseball, hockey, handball, volleyball, American football) over every meeting in our data (all competitions, no friendlies): won, drawn and lost from team_a's side (home_team_* fields = team_a), goals (the sport's

tools.name: get_league_facts
tools.description: What finished matches changed, newest first: the match story (comebacks, late winners, red cards), runs started or ended, table places and zones, each also as a sentence (lang de, es, it, fr). Use for 'what happened in this league today'. Facts only. Insights feature.

tools.name: get_live_matches
tools.description: Matches in play right now, with score and minute or period, and the TV channels showing them where known.

tools.name: get_match
tools.description: One match: teams, score, status, events (goals, cards...), venue, referee; where known TV channels by country and, after the match, a highlights video link. tools.description: Matches (fixtures and results) by day or date range, optionally of one league, or one team's matches in every competition (team_id; without status or dates its latest results, then live, then next matches; with status scheduled only the next ones, with finished only the latest results). tools.name: get_mma_event
tools.description: One MMA card from the main event down (weight class, fighters, winner, method, round, time, judges' scores, fight stats), or with bout_id one fight.

tools.name: get_mma_events
tools.description: MMA (UFC) fight cards by date: name, date, status and the main event with its result once known.

tools.name: get_mma_fighter
tools.description: An MMA fighter's record (wins, losses, draws, no contests; wins and losses by KO/TKO, submission, decision) from the bouts held since 2026, with the last fights; where Wikipedia/Wikidata has the fighter also the profile (birth date, height, reach, stance, nationality, weight class, team), the career

tools.name: get_race
tools.description: One horse race card: runners with number, horse, jockey, trainer, weight, rating, recent form where the feed has it, best current price and morning line; once settled the result (positions, starting prices, finish codes such as PU or F) and results_final.

tools.name: get_race_briefing
tools.description: Ready briefing for one horse race from our results: field size, distance, going, class, the favourite, each runner's form figures and last run, jockey and trainer strike rates over the last 30 days; after the race the winner, starting price and whether the favourite won. tools.name: get_races
tools.description: Horse races of a day (default today, UTC), optionally of one region or racecourse: off time, course, race name, distance, going, class, number of runners, status (NS, live, result_pending, FT, unlisted).

tools.name: get_racing_stats
tools.description: Stats from our stored results. kind jockey or trainer: runs, wins, places and strike rate over the last 14 and 30 days, overall and per region. kind course (last 365 days): favourite win rate, top jockeys and trainers by wins, draw by distance band in thirds of the stalls with sample sizes.

tools.name: get_runner_form
tools.description: Last runs of a horse, jockey or trainer in our stored results, latest first: date, course, distance, going, position and field size, starting price; plus wins, top-three finishes and strike rate over those runs.

tools.name: get_snooker_darts_player
tools.description: A snooker or darts player (player_id): country, world ranking, birth date (Wikidata), titles and finals in the stored seasons, latest matches; or find players by name.

tools.name: get_snooker_darts_tournament
tools.description: A snooker or darts tournament with its whole draw (qualifying first, the final last): round, players, seeds, frames/legs/sets won, best of, three-dart averages where listed; snooker also the century breaks per player.

tools.name: get_snooker_darts_tournaments
tools.description: Snooker (World Snooker Tour ranking and invitational events) or darts (PDC majors, World Series, Players Championships, European Tour) tournaments of the current and last season from Wikipedia: dates, venue, prize fund, winner, final score.
